title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider Visit Fee: Collection on Rider Service Requests
content:
**Rule.** Under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, every new-failure rider service request owes one rider visit fee, collected on the request, unless it is serviced in the same visit and trade as a base contract request.

**Same visit and trade.** For a rider on a homeowner service contract, a rider request counts as serviced in the same visit and trade as a base contract request only when that same homeowner contract has a service request in the same trade placed on the same day, and then, the rider's published terms carrying no separate fee in a shared visit, no rider visit fee is charged; for a rider on a rental property or real estate contract, when the rider's published terms carry no separate fee in a shared visit, no rider fee is charged when the component is serviced in the same visit and trade as an open request on that base contract.

**Weekend requests.** A rider request placed on a Saturday or Sunday is logged without its fee, and the fee is collected by the representative who next handles the request with the customer.

**Scope.** For a rider on a homeowner service contract this policy sets the service call fee of a new-failure rider request, and only for such a rider; a rider on a rental property or real estate contract still carries the base tier's service call fee.

**Effect.** The fee is a service call fee entry on the billing ledger of the rider the request was placed under, linked to that request and dated the day it is collected. It counts toward the service call fees collected on the rider, and the customer sees it on the rider's billing history at once.

## Collecting the fee: `charge_rider_visit_fee_fc58860f`

**Capability.** The tool collects the service call fee on one rider service request, booking a new service call fee entry dated today on the billing ledger of the rider the request was placed under, linked to that request.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `addon_service_request_id` | The rider service request number the fee is collected on, as returned by the rider service request lookup. | Identifier |
| `amount` | The service call fee in USD. | Non-negative amount with 2 decimal places; rounded to the nearest cent before it is booked |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Service call fee <entry reference> of USD <amount> collected on rider service request <request number> under rider <rider reference>." The entry reference is the new billing entry's reference number and the amount is in USD with 2 decimal places; its presence means the fee was booked.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Called with a request number and `amount` 100.00, the tool returns a receipt naming a new entry reference, USD 100.00, the request number and the rider reference.
